decisions.reason: The net price display plugin builds partially on the firm's price-related knowledge, giving moderate absorptive capacity to learn from early results.
The ERP system interface plugin is distant from the firm's core market research knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
Price comparison tracking directly leverages the firm's existing competitive price analysis capabilities, resulting in high absorptive capacity.
